source: They come to us distracted, absentmindedly, as though they were off to a masquerade, only curiosity leading them on. And the ladies, ah, the ladies, they appear decked out in all their finery, mounting their own little play, and what’s more, without pay.
translation: 他们心不在焉、心不在焉地来到我们身边，就像是去参加一场化装舞会，只有好奇心引导着他们。而女士们，啊，女士们，她们打扮得漂漂亮亮，上演着自己的小戏，更重要的是，没有报酬。
